title: wezterminator engine state
description: state.json in the engine state directory. Watched by WezTerm, so only the TUI and CLI write it, never Lua during config evaluation. Recorded screens live in the sibling screens.json (see $defs/screens_document), which is deliberately not watched. Keys starting with an underscore are comments: '_' describes the enclosing object, '_<key>' describes the sibling '<key>'.

history.description: Undo stack of previously active presets, oldest first, capped at 20. A commit pushes the outgoing preset and drops the oldest entry beyond the cap. Undo pops the newest entry and makes it active.

engine.description: Written by the Lua engine so the Rust side reads the same built-ins the running Lua uses.

schema_version.description: Highest document schema_version the engine supports.

screens_document.description: screens.json. Device-pixel sizes of the connected screens, written by Lua from a GUI event and only when the list changed. Art is generated for the screen with the largest pixel area.
